dedupe_keys.name: openentrance case study 7 power to heat demand flexibility results

description: The openENTRANCE team publishes an Excel results workbook for its Danish power-to-heat flexibility case. Zenodo provides the file under CC BY 4.0. The record names Plan4EU, a European electricity-dispatch model, linked through Frigg to a Flexibility Function demand-response model. It compares end-consumer power-to-heat response and heat storage in a 2050 Danish electricity-system setting. The results can benchmark alternative assumptions about flexible heat demand in sector-coupled energy simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this case output workbook. Coverage is the Danish case and the modelled 2050 system, not observed household response. A limitation is that the own page does not define every workbook sheet or disclose all calibration inputs, so figures cannot be interpreted as validated savings without the linked report. The workbook was not downloaded and the coupled models were not rerun.
